59070c6d11.why: The three stores, three checksum XORs and xmm15 copy each contribute a required effect with no SSE2 fusion available.

36506e87bb.why: The four stores, four checksum XORs and xmm15 copy are all required and cannot be reduced with the permitted instructions.

f5d30f16fb.why: All three loaded values contribute to required XMM outputs, and both XORs and both pointer updates are necessary.

fcdf794eed.why: The AES result, scalar copies, store, pointer update and carry-producing subtraction are all required and cannot be combined.

2a44ceeca2.why: The store and all four final zeroed XMM registers are required, and SSE2 has no instruction that clears multiple XMM registers.

2a2650c6fa.why: All five instructions establish required scalar outputs, including both copies of the adjusted pointer.

fd96e5829c.why: The original input, both loaded keys, the chaining value, the XOR result and the updated key pointer must all remain available.

895529df84.why: The AES operation, chaining XOR, two stores and four required XMM clears have no instruction-count reduction under SSE2 and AES-NI.
